verdict.rationale: GitLab provides Git version control and merge-request review, and agent instructions live in a repo file (AGENTS.md), so some automation configuration can be versioned and reviewed. Nothing in the evidence explicitly ties custom flows or agents to versioning, and nothing documents rolling an automation back. missing for 10: explicit versioning of custom flows/agents and CI automation definitions, a documented rollback/revert of automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Work with the Git version control system.
Agents turn issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities, and review code while your team stays in control.
Create an AGENTS.md file to provide instructions.
You define the workflow steps and agents, and define triggers to control when the flow runs.
